A small Windows update for people who couldn't get adb.

## Fixed

- Google blocks downloads of its Android tools in some countries, and **get from Google** used to just fail there with "Google's server said 404". Now it explains what's going on and lets you use an adb you got some other way instead (adb.exe or the whole platform-tools zip). Look for **Use my own adb…** in Advanced, or the **pick one you already have** link that shows up in Add phone after a failed download. Wi-Fi pairing never needed adb and keeps working without it.
- Settings > Apps kept showing the version Telescope was first installed as, even after updating. It now shows the current one.

The phone app has no changes in this release.

Found something broken? Open an issue and paste your **Copy diagnostics** report into it.
